answer_sentences.text: No, the 2% pre-payment charge is not allowed for a Rs 40 lakh loan for a Tier 3 UCB, because Tier 3 UCBs shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh.
answer_sentences.quote: A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh.

answer_sentences.text: Although the sanction letter states a 2% pre-payment charge, that clause conflicts with the RBI direction for Tier 3 UCBs on loans up to ₹50 lakh.
answer_sentences.quote: 2.2 Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid.
